title: Mangalnath Temple Ujjain: Birthplace of Planet Mars & Center of Astrology
content:
Mangalnath Temple Ujjain

Mangalnath Temple is one of the most important and unique temples in Ujjain, dedicated to Lord Mangal (Mars). It is believed to be the birthplace of planet Mars, making it a globally significant site for astrology and planetary worship. Located on a peaceful hill overlooking the Shipra River, the temple offers a calm, divine, and uplifting spiritual experience.

History & Significance

According to ancient texts, Ujjain (Avanti) was the centre of astronomy and astrology.
Mangalnath Temple is mentioned in the Skanda Purana as the place where Mars originated, giving it immense astrological importance.

People come here to perform Mangal Dosha puja, Navagraha puja, and special rituals to remove obstacles, improve marital life, and bring peace.

Why Visit Mangalnath Temple?

1. Birthplace of Mars (Mangal Grah): This is the only temple in the world where Mars is worshipped at its origin point.

2. Perfect Place for Astrology Pujas: Daily rituals are performed by experienced priests for: Mangal Dosha Shanti, Navagraha Shanti, Marriage-related pujas, Career and obstacle-removal rituals.

3. Beautiful Location: The temple stands on a serene hilltop with a stunning view of the Shipra River. Sunrise here is truly breathtaking.

4. Peaceful Spiritual Experience: Compared to other busy temples in Ujjain, Mangalnath offers quietness, purity, and deep spiritual vibrations.

Nearby Attractions

  • Kal Bhairav Temple  - 5 km
  • Mahakaleshwar Temple - 4.5 km
  • Harsiddhi Temple - 4 km
  • Ram Ghat - 4.5 km
  • Sandipani Ashram - 3.5 km

Best Time to Visit

  • Tuesday (special day of Lord Mangal)
  • Early morning for peaceful darshan
  • October to March for pleasant weather

Travel Tips

  • Best to visit early to avoid queues during Tuesday.
  • Consult temple priests before performing any puja.
  • Carry water and comfortable footwear.
  • Maintain silence and cleanliness.
